description: Why can't this user sign in? Reads the user's recent Microsoft Entra sign-ins in YOUR tenant (with your read-only Graph token) and returns each failure decoded (AADSTS meaning), the Conditional Access policy that blocked it and what it required, app, device compliance, location and correlation ID, grouped into findings with fixes. Needs AuditLog.Read.All and Entra ID P1/P2. Token never stored. Costs $0.05 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

graph_token.description: MCP only: your Microsoft Graph access token (read-only app registration; see https://microsoft.l50automation.com/microsoft/tenant-setup). Over HTTP send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer' header instead. Used once, never stored or logged.

user.description: User sign-in name (user@domain) or object ID
